title: Incident Trail
summary: Investigate a deterministic synthetic incident and submit evidence.
description: A fictional system has a suspicious configuration change, repeated authentication failures, and a file with an incorrect mode. Investigate the supplied files, independently verify the permission and event counts, and produce `incident-report.json` with evidence and remediation.

workspace_seed.incident/events.log:

2026-05-11T11:01Z CONFIG_CHANGE path=/etc/app.conf
2026-05-11T11:03Z AUTH_FAIL account=ops
2026-05-11T11:04Z AUTH_FAIL account=service
2026-05-11T11:05Z HEALTH status=ok
workspace_seed.incident/context.txt: All names and events in this mission are fictional. Confirm evidence before drawing conclusions.

offline_hints.title: Think about the concept
offline_hints.content: Use an incident-response approach: preserve observations, verify each claim, and distinguish evidence from assumptions.

offline_hints.title: Investigate this area
offline_hints.content: Inspect `incident/`, run counts over its synthetic logs, and examine the mode on `incident/restore-plan.txt`.

offline_hints.title: Guided route
offline_hints.content: Correct `incident/restore-plan.txt` to mode 640. Write `incident-report.json` containing `failed_logins: 3`, `config_changes: 1`, `permission_mode: "640"`, and `remediation: "rotate credentials and review config change"`.

expected.remediation: rotate credentials and review config change

completion_explanation: You completed Incident Trail. Review the evidence, compare the observed result with the expected state, and explain why it matters in a real defensive workflow.

network_requirements.description: No network interface is required for this mission.
